method: Reviewed the original ReAct paper and current Anthropic stop-reason/tool-use documentation. Re-audited the complete lesson and ran its standard-library-only deterministic fixture verifier under Python 3.14.7; no provider or network calls.

checks: empty end_turn not counted as success
repeat action stops before second dispatch
duplicate tool IDs reject whole batch
tool budget preflight prevents partial batch
model turn and tool-call counts remain separate

limitations: Historical ReAct provider outputs, usage, latency, and scorer artifacts from 2026-10-09/12 were not archived and were not independently reproduced.
The synthetic fixture validates only its local host-control branches; it does not establish model branch selection, live API behavior, production authorization, side-effect safety, or billing.
The exact-repeat detector is a local heuristic and may reject legitimate repeated reads or miss other forms of no progress; production policy needs task-specific state and hard budgets.
